entities.name: Stella Lee
entities.description: A human Atiin nomad and thrill-seeking Slickshot duelist, knife thrower, acrobat and mage on Thunder Junction.

entities.name: Slickshot Gang
entities.description: A gang on Thunder Junction that employs Stella for jobs.

entities.name: Atiin
entities.description: Nomadic people of Stella's home plane.

entities.name: Annie Flash
entities.description: Fellow Atiin and a friend of Stella.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: Paths between planes that opened in 4562 AR.

entities.name: Lucy Bluff
entities.description: A friend of Stella who died and was buried in Thief's Folly.

entities.name: Thief's Folly
entities.description: The greatest graveyard on Thunder Junction.

entities.name: Gisa Cecani
entities.description: Twin necromancer from Innistrad searching for a map in the graveyard.

entities.name: Geralf Cecani
entities.description: Twin necromancer from Innistrad, Gisa's brother.

entities.name: Quintorius Kand
entities.description: A planeswalker who foiled Stella's smuggling scheme on Arcavios.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: Plane with an archaeological site Stella tried to loot.

events.summary: When the Omenpaths open in 4562 AR, Stella joins her people in traveling to new planes.
events.quote: When the Omenpaths opened in 4562 AR , she joined her people in traveling to new planes.

events.summary: Stella joins the Slickshot Gang on Thunder Junction.
events.quote: she joined the plane's Slickshot Gang

events.summary: Stella visits Lucy Bluff's grave at Thief's Folly and helps Gisa and Geralf Cecani defeat a zombie centipede so the grave is not disturbed.
events.quote: Stella helped the siblings defeat the zombie so Lucy's grave wouldn't be disturbed.

events.summary: Stella's antique-smuggling scheme on Arcavios fails after she runs afoul of Quintorius Kand and retreats without her plunder.
events.quote: she ran afoul of the planeswalker Quintorius Kand and was forced to retreat without her plunder

relations.quote: She is a member of the Slickshot Gang .
is a friend of fellow Atiin Annie Flash

relations.note: Helped the twins defeat a zombie.
relations.quote: Stella helped the siblings defeat the zombie

relations.note: Ran afoul of him on Arcavios.
relations.quote: she ran afoul of the planeswalker Quintorius Kand
